title: Too large for my purpose
text: Too large for my purpose. This is an attractive bowl --  it's just larger than I thought and I will probably never use it. Will just give it away so someone else can get some use out of it.

product_metadata.title: Spectrum Diversified Shapes/Circles Round Fruit Bowl, Chrome
features: MODERN GEOMETRY: With clean, smooth lines, this geometry-inspired kitchen organizer introduces a fresh, contemporary style. The modern finishes complement a variety of kitchen styles and color schemes, showing off your style in the best light.

OPEN DESIGN ENCOURAGES EVEN RIPENING: Wire storage limits overripening, expanding the window in which you can enjoy your fruits and vegetables. Air circulation prevents buildup of ethylene gas, so your fruits will stay fresh for longer.

STORE A VARIETY OF FRUIT: Basket is perfect for all your produce: apples, pears, lemons, limes, grapefruit, kiwis, bananas, and other fruits in convenient countertop food storage. Alternatively, use your fruit basket for vegetables.

CONVENIENT COUNTERTOP STORAGE: Keep produce nearby by displaying it on the counter. Encourage your family to choose a healthy snack by leaving out apples, oranges, pears, or bananas. Keep produce in beautiful food storage for healthier eating.
DIMENSIONS & CARE: 11" L X 11" W X 5.5" H; to clean, wipe down with a damp cloth and towel dry. Wipe down as necessary to prevent dirt buildup..
description: Display your fruits and vegetables in style with the Circle Shapes Fruit Bowl from Spectrum Diversified. The fun and interesting shapes make a delightfully modern piece that will add a whimsical touch to your home. Wire storage limits overripening, expanding the window in which you can enjoy your fruits and vegetables. Keep produce nearby by displaying it on the counter. Encourage your family to choose a healthy snack by leaving out apples, oranges, pears, or bananas. Keep produce in beautiful food storage for healthier eating. Air circulation prevents buildup of ethylene gas, so your fruits will stay fresh for longer. Basket is perfect for all your produce: apples, pears, lemons, limes, grapefruit, kiwis, bananas, and other fruits in convenient countertop food storage. Alternatively, use your fruit basket for vegetables. This bowl is the perfect addition to your home whether you are serving bread rolls, storing fruits, or displaying decorative ornaments during the holidays. With clean, smooth lines, this geometry-inspired kitchen organizer introduces a fresh, contemporary style. The modern finishes complement a variety of kitchen styles and color schemes, showing off your style in the best light. Made of sturdy steel.
